[[File:Yahichi.png|thumb|250px|Yahichi]]
(Japanese: '''ヤヒチ''' ''Yahichi'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP173|Wobbu-Palooza!]]''. He is a man who lives in [[Wobbuffet Village]]. He is not named in the English [[dub]], but is referred to as '''Mustache Guy''' in the closed captions available on [[Prime Video]].

His {{p|Wobbuffet}} was attacked by the [[Wobbuffet Festival crashers]], during the [[Wobbuffet Festival]], and he was the second person of the village whose Wobbuffet was attacked. The Wobbuffet Festival Crashers had caught him and his Wobbuffet completely by surprise. When {{Ash}}, {{ashfr}} and [[Norio]] came to visit him to hear what had happened, he informed them that there were three attackers.
